name: AI retrieval-augmented generation service
description: Synthetic proposed workload: a self-hosted vector/search service whose persistent index, content/metadata, and write-path files use filesystem volumes backed by the assessed block storage — a deployment assumption for this scenario, not a requirement of RAG. Two phases: query-time retrieval load and nightly ingestion/index maintenance (weekdays 02:00–05:00). Storage demand only; the advisor does not model GPU inference, token-generation performance, or a universal RAG benchmark, and corpus sources or model execution may sit outside the assessed storage.
assumptions: schedule is stylized piecewise demand with no jitter
throughput is derived from IOPS and block sizes, never an independent input
peak IOPS is the schedule maximum and is informational only

deployment assumes a self-hosted vector/search service whose index, content/metadata, and write-path files sit on filesystem volumes backed by the assessed block storage; this is a scenario choice, not a requirement of RAG

two modeled phases: query-time retrieval (08:00–20:00 weekdays, lighter on weekends) versus ingestion/index maintenance (weekdays 02:00–05:00 — a three-hour window that is a substantial synthetic assumption)
ingestion uses 64 KiB blocks, deliberately exceeding the 16 KiB modeled backend block
GPU inference, token generation, embedding throughput, and corpus sourcing are outside the model and may consume no assessed storage

schedule.name: ingestion
schedule.note: three-hour ingestion/index-maintenance window — a substantial synthetic assumption
